lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p9 - Listen, point and say.

details: Listen, point and say checks understanding of word meaning and sound. Listen and point shows they match what they hear to the right image. Say practises first-step pronunciation.
Look for careful listening, correct pointing, clear sounds, and confident repetition.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p9 - Talk about the picture and match.

details: Point and match gives students controlled practice identifying the target language and showing their understanding of the questions What is this? and Where’s the…?
Look for correct matching of the  items in the picture dictionary strips to the same items in the main scene and accurate pointing to the rooms where the items are found.

Say gives students further controlled practice of the target language and helps them progress from saying single words to linking the target language to make simple phrases.
Look for correct identification and accurate pronunciation of the target language, and an attempt to talk about it using simple phrases e.g. bath…in the bathroom.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p9 - 3. Say the chant.

details: Say the chant strengthens retention of the target language and helps improve pronunciation and stress.
Look for correct stress and confident participation, with most students able to join in with at least the most repeated parts of the chant.
